headline: Supply-Path Transparency for Demand Partners
subheadline: sellers.json lets buyers verify where inventory originates — so if traffic comes from publisher XYZ, demand partners can see that clearly across the supply chain.

sections.title: What is sellers.json?
sections.body: sellers.json is an IAB Tech Lab standard hosted at the root of our domain. It is the public ledger counterpart to publisher app-ads.txt files, allowing DSPs and programmatic buyers to verify the entities selling or mediating ad inventory.

sections.title: Supply chain visibility
sections.body: When Mira Media mediates traffic from a publisher, demand partners should be able to identify that publisher in the supply path. This file is how we publish that transparency — aligning publisher identity with advertiser trust.

sections.title: Anti-IVT & standards
sections.body: We support pre-filtered invalid traffic controls and IAB-aligned compliance practices so buyers receive cleaner CTV bid streams with verified origin tracking.
